subject: Private deployment expansion: split routing plane & audit window alignment
messages:
From: Ops Lead <opslead@medicore.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@medicore.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Expansion request for Private environment at renewal

Hi Markus —

We’re approaching the renewal window (Dec 31) and Ops wants to add a second isolated VPC in our US region for analytics processing (separate from the existing staging cluster). Two asks from our side: 1) add an additional cluster pair (2x GPUs, burst capacity) behind a dedicated routing plane so we can route sensitive workloads there; 2) align the audit/log retention window to 18 months for that new environment (legal is asking about preserved audit trails).

High level timeline: procurement needs a confirmed scope and subscription delta by Dec 15 to get a PO out the door.

Can you confirm feasibility and a rough cost delta? Also flag any compliance evidence you’ll need (SOC2 items, KMS details).

Thanks,
Marta Reyes
Ops Lead, Medicore Analytics
(opslead@medicore.com)

Attachments: none
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 13:42:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Expansion request for Private environment at renewal

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear ask. We can support both items, with a few clarifications before I lock pricing:

- Proposed architecture: provision an additional VPC + 2 dedicated clusters (primary + standby) in us-west-2. To meet your routing isolation requirement we recommend a split control plane (shared control plane in Dedicated tenant) and separate data plane within the new VPC so you get strict traffic separation while keeping operational overhead reasonable.

- Audit/log retention: 18 months is feasible. We’ll need to confirm storage tiering (hot/warm/cold) and whether the logs must be exported to your S3 or kept in Redwood’s audit storage for eDiscovery.

- Security/compliance needs: please confirm if you require Customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key). If yes, we’ll include KMS integration as an add-on. For SOC2 evidence I’ve attached a high-level checklist and a scoped config proposal that maps requested artifacts to delivery timing.

- Pricing & term: Because this is a renewal + expansion we can offer a 2% price uplift per additional cluster if you commit to a 36-month extended term for the new environment. If you prefer year-to-year we’ll keep it at list rate but without the extended-term credit. Draft numbers are in the attached scoped-config-proposal.pdf.

Next steps I propose: 1) you confirm the KMS preference and retention export destination; 2) procurement confirms target PO date; 3) we sync for a short technical call this week to walk the scoped proposal.

I’ve attached: scoped-config-proposal.pdf (high-level topology + pricing estimate). I’ll follow up with an SLA amendment draft for legal.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Subject: Questions on purchase process and compliance items

Markus / Neha — procurement here. A few clarifying questions before we proceed to PO:

1) Will Redwood accept Medicore’s standard PO terms (net 45) or do you require net 30? Any early-pay discounts?
2) On KMS: are you able to support external HSM integrations or only cloud KMS? Our security team prefers a vendor-locked HSM model for the new cluster.
3) For audit retention: if Redwood retains logs for 18 months, can Medicore request on-demand exports for eDiscovery (we may need snapshots preserved off-platform)?
4) Please confirm you can provide the SOC2 artifacts listed in the checklist and provide a point of contact for security intake.

If you can confirm items 1–4 by EOD Dec 10 we should be able to route the PO soon after.

Thanks,
Anil Desai

Subject: RE: Questions on purchase process and compliance items

Hi Anil — copying answers below and next steps. Short version: yes on most items, with minor operational notes.

1) Payment terms: Redwood typically operates on net 30. We can accommodate net 45 on larger enterprise commitments (>= $250k ARR) — if you confirm a 36-month term at the proposed expansion levels we can accept net 45. No standard early-pay discount in the studio plan; we can add a 1% early-pay credit for 15-day settlement on the amendment.

2) KMS/HSM: We support cloud KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) out of the box. We also support customer-managed HSM integrations for on-prem/private installs via our KMS adapter — this requires a 2-week integration window and an ops runbook; it will be listed as a professional services line item in the amendment.

3) Audit exports: Redwood can provide on-demand export snapshots (S3 export or signed bundle) for eDiscovery. Exports are charged at a small O(GB) transfer fee; we’ll include a sample export workflow in the SLA amendment.

4) SOC2 artifacts & security intake: attached is our SOC2-evidence-list.csv mapping artifacts to delivery windows. Primary contact for security intake will be Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwood.ai). We can run an intake call and a tabletop review; please share available slots (I can do 12/11 or 12/14 after 10am PT).

Next steps (action owners):
- Markus: finalize 1-page pricing delta and update scoped-config-proposal with the HSM PS line (by 12/9)
- Neha: confirm preferred term (12/9)
- Medicore Ops/Procurement: confirm PO timeline and whether net 45 is required (12/10)
- Kimberly: schedule security intake (12/11 or 12/14)

I’ll prepare the SLA amendment (SLA-amendment-draft.docx) for legal review after pricing is confirmed.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
